capabilities: Import NetEase Cloud Music songs into notes
Import Discogs collection records into notes
Render notes from a swappable Markdown template
Keep covers as URLs or download them locally
disambiguation: Not a vault or cross-device sync tool; 'sync' means importing external music and record collections into notes.
extras: Full documentation is in Chinese; the English text is a reviewer summary. Desktop only. No audio is downloaded, only metadata, lyrics and tracklists. The Discogs half works standalone without NetEase.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn your music listening history or physical record collection into structured notes.

relations.evidence: translated titles from NetEase's official endpoint
uses the official API + a personal token to pull your entire collection
reads the local cache of MusicLyricApp (metadata + timestamped lyrics)

summary: Music sync plugin that turns NetEase Cloud Music songs and Discogs records into notes with metadata, lyrics and tracklists, deduplicated by ID.
